posts.title: 清理磁盘已满的mysql
posts.description: 简介 早上有个同事问我能不能扩容磁盘，说mysql 存储满了，只能扩容磁盘，我进服务器看了下，的确，给mysql 数据目录单独挂载了一块磁盘，然后这块磁盘满了，貌似确实没有什么东西可以删除，没有日志可以删除，没有除了mysql数据以外的东西可以删除，问了下AI 可以删除binlog 正常清理binlog 要mysql 进程可以使用链接到mysql 才可以，但是这个时候mysql 进程已经挂了，只能清理binlog文件

posts.title: When the Namespace Dropdown in the Argo Rollouts Dashboard Disappeared
posts.description: Introduction In the Argo Rollouts dashboard, the NAMESPACE field had turned from a dropdown into a disabled input box. All I could see was the default namespace, and there was no way to switch somewhere else and look at other rollouts. I went through the source code, checked permissions, turned on debug logs, and after all that the culprit turned out to be a single rollout that had the wrong type

posts.title: 记一次ArgoRollouts Dashboard的namespace下拉框消失
posts.description: 简介 Argo Rollouts 的 Dashboard 页面里，NAMESPACE 那个位置从下拉框变成了一个禁用的输入框，只能看到默认的 namespace，没法切到别的地方看 rollout。翻源码、查权限、开调试日志折腾了一圈，最后发现凶手是一个 rollout 的资源字段写错了类型，导致整个集群级的列表解码失败。这篇记录一下排查过程。
